title: app_box target derivation table
description: DATA, not code (R3; architecture §11). One entry per platform target -> the viewports it implies + the platform ceremonies the scaffold must emit. Adding a target is a data edit: append an entry here, nothing in gate code changes. Viewport NAMES reference config/app-box.config.json viewports (the widths live there, NEVER here). Ceremony 'checks' are path/key specs the coverage gate (C5) asserts against the app root; absence fails the gate naming the missing file (6.8). 'inherits' pulls a parent's viewports AND ceremonies before this entry's own.

targets.description: target id -> { viewports:[name...], ceremonies:[...], inherits?:id }. Every target an operator may pass to --targets MUST have an entry here; an unknown target fails derivation loudly.

viewports.description: viewport names this target implies; resolved against config viewports for widths

ceremonies.description: platform files/keys the scaffold must emit for this target

id.description: stable ceremony identifier (gate messages cite this)

path.description: file path relative to the app root

key.description: if present, the file must contain this token (plist key, XML key, manifest member)

inherits.description: pull this target's viewports+ceremonies before own (e.g. pwa inherits web)

ceremonies.desc: iOS local-network usage description + Bonjour services (NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription / NSBonjourServices)
Keychain Sharing entitlement in BOTH DebugProfile and Release (flutter_secure_storage; an App Group declared but omitted here is the silent -34018 write failure)
